suitableFor: adventure / trip fact sheets (Activity, Adventure Type, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price)
product spec / metadata panels rendered as key/value pairs
any structured label-above-value summary panel with a left accent border
notSuitableFor: true tabular data with a header row and multiple data columns (use the base 'table' block / striped / bordered variants)
grids of cards with images (use cards-teaser)

notes: NEW variant created for the adventure-detail template. Based on the project's LOCAL table block (does NOT import moveInstrumentation or fetchPlaceholders - compatible with this project's older aem.js/scripts.js). Authoring model is the standard 2-column table (label | value per row); JS renders each row as a stacked <dt>/<dd> definition pair with a left yellow (#ffea00 WKND brand) accent border, replacing the vanilla gridlined <table> rendering. DA project, so NO _table-facts.json model file. Reused across all 16 adventure-detail pages (us/en + ca/en).
